_comment: SPEC EVT1 — per-type `data` payload shapes for the load-bearing event types. events.schema.json constrains only the `type` enum; `data` was free-form, so two skills could emit the same type with different shapes and readers crashed or silently dropped fields. This is a CUSTOM mini-schema (no jsonschema dependency): each type maps to {required, properties, description}. `required` is a list of ALIAS-GROUPS — a group is satisfied if ANY key in it is present (absorbs the documented drift: due~due_date, status~state, owner~owner_id~owner_person_id, the resolver closer-id chain). `properties` type-checks declared keys when present. Unknown keys are always allowed (permissive forward-compat). Enforced WARN-ONLY at write time (never blocks); promotion to blocking is a later release after a zero-warning burn-in. Canonical for the consumers in cru_match.py / brief_state.py / value_receipt.py / render_decision_log.py.

commitment.description: An open promise. Aliases tolerated by cru_match._commitment_field: due~due_date, status~state, owner_id~owner_person_id~owner, id (minted cmt_<ulid> at write time by the append gate when absent; read by _commitment_id). kind (promise|task|scheduling|agenda) is REQUIRED AT CAPTURE (Stage D; strict path rejects, legacy path warns+stamps promise). Stage E receipts: counterparty_id (REQUIRED when determinable — feeds the CRU candidacy gate; retires requester_* for new writes) + counterparty_name (free-text fallback). Closers reference it via data.commitment_id.

commitment_resolved.description: Closes a commitment. WRITTEN ONLY via commitment_state.close_commitment() (Phase 2 Stage B, F2 — the single closure path: id normalization, loud no-match, full-set idempotency, pending_review floor). References the commitment via one of the closer-id aliases (cru_match closer chain): commitment_id~thread_id~id~target_id, or a seq alias (commitment_seq~source_event_seq, F3 amnesty chain). The append gate REJECTS closures carrying none of these (Phase 1). close_commitment writes data.commitment_id (canonical) + resolved_by + evidence (≤200 chars) + resolution (done|dropped|superseded).

commitment_reclassified.description: Kind override marker (Phase 2 Stage D, S6/S5) — additive; the projector applies data.new_kind to the referenced commitment read-side (history never rewritten). Written by the S6 migration script (promise→task partition) and promote_task_to_commitment (task→promise, one-tap promote when a counterparty appears). Never delete/recreate.

commitment_reopened.description: Reopens a closed commitment (Phase 2 Stage D, S4 undo) — additive; the projector honors the LATEST of closure vs reopen in append order. Written by the triage undo path via commitment_state.reopen_commitment.

decision.description: A logged decision. The decision text lives under one of: decision~summary~title.

meeting.description: A meeting record. Has a title or summary.

meeting_processed.description: A processed meeting. References the meeting and carries a summary/title.

interaction.description: A passive-capture touchpoint. Carries a source_ref (dedup key) or a summary.

email_drafted.description: A draft produced by email-writer (event fires from apply-choices on click).

email_sent.description: A sent email; closure event linking back via draft_event_seq. gmail_thread_id (B6) when the send response provides it.

pack_run.description: Audit/telemetry trail of a scheduled-task / orchestrator fire.

pattern_break_detected.description: A person whose contact cadence broke (Pulse). Carries the person and the diagnostic counts.
